title: Learning the identity: a case study of how SGD selects among functional decompositions
abstract: arXiv:2610.00615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One might think that learning the identity function with a deep linear residual network is trivial - the path along residual connections already implements the identity, and so the network need only drive its weights to zero. However, this zero-weight solution is just one point on an entire manifold of population-loss minimizers, each corresponding to a different decomposition of the identity across the network's layers. Although the population loss does not distinguish among these solutions, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) reproducibly favors particular ones. For instance, under anisotropic label noise, the learned layers exhibit a noise-dependent spectrum; even with weight decay, SGD does not generally recover the zero-weight solution. translated_title: 学习恒等函数：SGD如何在多种函数分解之间进行选择的案例研究
translated_abstract: 人们可能认为，用深度线性残差网络学习恒等函数是件轻而易举的事——沿着残差连接的路径本身已经实现了恒等映射，因此网络只需将权重驱动到零即可。然而，这个零权重解只是由总体损失极小值构成的整个流形上的一个点，流形上的每个点都对应恒等函数在网络各层间的一种不同分解。尽管总体损失无法区分这些解，随机梯度下降（SGD）却能可复现地偏好其中某些特定的解。例如，在各向异性标签噪声下，学习到的各层会呈现出依赖于噪声的谱结构；即使加入权重衰减，SGD通常也不会恢复到零权重解。仅在参数化方式上做出改变、同时保持可实现的函数集合不变，就会产生不同的行为：将每个权重矩阵因式分解为两个矩阵的乘积会使权重……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文以深度线性残差网络学习恒等函数为案例，揭示出总体损失虽然无法区分由恒等函数在各层间不同分解构成的整个极小值流形，SGD却能可复现地偏好其中特定解，且这种隐式选择依赖于标签噪声的各向异性和参数化方式，即使加入权重衰减也通常不会恢复零权重解。
en_tdlr: Through a case study of learning the identity function with deep linear residual networks, this paper shows that SGD reproducibly selects particular solutions from a manifold of equivalent identity decompositions that the population loss cannot distinguish, with this implicit selection shaped by label-noise anisotropy and parametrization, and weight decay generally failing to recover the zero-weight solution.
